enchantments.tooltip: Improved Insightful False Life: Passive +20 Insight bonus to Hit Points.
Insightful Constitution +4: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +4 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Insightful Natural Armor Bonus +5: This item increases the wearer's natural ability to resist physical damage giving a +5 natural armor bonus to AC.
Insightful Fortitude Save +3: This item gives a +3 Insight bonus to your Fortitude saves.
Epic Griffon Set: While wearing both items from the Epic Griffon Set, you gain: +2 Quality bonus to Constitution
Epic The Devil's Handiwork: While wearing any five items from the Epic The Devil's Handiwork, you gain: +3 Quality bonus to all Ability stats
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
